title: Story premise ENT015: The Shadow Race
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: Your shadow is cheating. Takeaway/theme: Agree on the rules before comparing results.
description: Two friends race to get their shadows across a finish mark first, but a movable stage lamp lets each enlarge or shrink their shadow instead of running. They eventually lock the lamp in place and race their hands as shadow animals, ending in a tied nose-touch at the line.
